ui.extensions.review.title: Review and installation
ui.extensions.review.lead: The server prepares each candidate. A human superadmin reviews the exact package and decides. Text from an agent is never an approval.

ui.extensions.review.isolation_lead: Declarative views do not run module code in this page. A module with its own frontend code runs in an isolated frame without access to your session. Server code runs in a restricted process without network, secrets or access to the core database, and keeps its data in its own SQLite database. Changes to assets and incidents go through the public services with your permissions. Review the digest, the permissions, the migrations and the history before approving.
